---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: model
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:              "Model summary"
  model_name:         ""
  model_desc:         ""
  image_file:         NULL
  logos:              NULL
  figure:             NULL
  config_df:          NULL
  counts_df:          NULL
  horizon_plot:       NULL
  geo_map:            NULL
  windows_group_plot: NULL
  windows_group_n:    0
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# One-two page glimpse of a model: configuration, contents, key figures.
# No inventories, no per-process sections -- those live in the standard and
# full model templates. Declaration-gating means none of the heavy
# components are even built for this template.
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
} else if (!is.null(params$image_file)) {
  emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
}
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$model_desc))) params$model_desc`

```{r en-figure, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$figure)}
emit_img(params$figure, 0.4)
```

## Configuration

```{r en-config, results='asis'}
tbl(params$config_df)
```

## Contents

```{r en-counts, results='asis'}
tbl(params$counts_df)
```

```{r en-horizon-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=2.6, eval=!is.null(params$horizon_plot)}
params$horizon_plot
```

```{r en-geo-map, fig.width=6, fig.height=4, eval=!is.null(params$geo_map)}
params$geo_map
```

```{r en-windows-grp, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$windows_group_plot)}
h_in <- min(5, max(2, 1 + 0.15 * params$windows_group_n))
emit_img(energyRt::report_plot_png(params$windows_group_plot, 7.5, h_in), 1)
```
